description: This file defines the UserDao interface, which extends a generic DAO for user-related database operations, including methods to retrieve users by username and store.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: An interface for user data access operations, extending a generic entity DAO.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity based on the provided username.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Returns a list of all User entities.

methods.name: listUserByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users associated with a specific merchant store.
